ApprovalDecision.description:
`signature_b64` signs ``zoro-approval-v1|{approval_id}|{action_digest}|{1 or 0}|{signed_at}``.

`level == biometric` must be signed with the approval (user-presence) key, otherwise the auth key.
ApprovalDecision.title: ApprovalDecision

ApprovalDecisionResult.description:
Answer of `POST /v1/approvals/{approval_id}/decision`.

`owner` says who was waiting: a suspended conversation turn ("turn": `events` holds the
resumed turn's events, in order, ending in `turn_completed`, `turn_suspended` or `error`),
an MCP call ("mcp") or an automation run ("automation": `run_id`). `status` is the owner's
own word for what happened next (for example "completed", "suspended", "denied", "running").
ApprovalDecisionResult.title: ApprovalDecisionResult

SignedProof.description:
Proof that a registered device (and, for the approval key, its owner) authorised an action.

Signed bytes (UTF-8): ``zoro-action-v1|{action}|{subject}|{signed_at}`` where ``signed_at`` is
formatted ``YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ``. ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256, DER signature, base64.
The server accepts a clock skew of 120 s and rejects replays.
SignedProof.title: SignedProof

post.description:
Streams raw 16-bit little-endian mono PCM. `X-Zoro-Sample-Rate` says the rate.
Send `X-Zoro-Data-Classes` (the classes of the text, e.g. from the turn) so the egress check
is exact; without it the text counts as personal.
